title: Grade 10 Mathematics — Real Numbers & Polynomials
description: Real Numbers and Polynomials practice questions
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Using Euclid's division algorithm, the HCF of 26 and 14 is:
Which of the following is an irrational number?
questions.explanation: √9 = 3, √(16/25) = 4/5, and 0.25 = 1/4 are all rational. √7 cannot be expressed as p/q, so it is irrational.

questions.question: If HCF(a, b) = 4 and LCM(a, b) = 48, then the product a × b equals:
questions.explanation: For any two positive integers, HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers. So a × b = 4 × 48 = 192.

questions.question: Using prime factorisation, the HCF of 96 and 120 is:
Is 6ⁿ divisible by 5 for any natural number n?
questions.explanation: 6ⁿ = (2 × 3)ⁿ = 2ⁿ × 3ⁿ. Its prime factors are only 2 and 3. Since 5 is not a factor of 6ⁿ, it is never divisible by 5.

questions.question: The largest number that divides 70 and 125, leaving remainders 5 and 8 respectively, is:
The zeros of the polynomial p(x) = x² − 7x + 12 are:
questions.explanation: x² − 7x + 12 = (x − 3)(x − 4). Setting each factor to zero: x = 3 and x = 4.

questions.question: The degree of the polynomial 4x⁴ − 3x³ + 2x² − x + 1 is:
questions.explanation: The degree of a polynomial is the highest power of the variable. Here, the highest power of x is 4.

questions.question: If α and β are zeros of 2x² − 5x + 3, then α + β equals:
questions.explanation: For a quadratic ax² + bx + c, sum of zeros = −b/a = −(−5)/2 = 5/2.

questions.question: If α and β are zeros of x² + 7x + 10, then αβ equals:
questions.explanation: For a quadratic ax² + bx + c, product of zeros = c/a = 10/1 = 10.

questions.question: A quadratic polynomial whose zeros are √3 and −√3 is:
questions.explanation: Sum of zeros = 0, product = −3. Polynomial = x² − (sum)x + product = x² − 0·x + (−3) = x² − 3.

questions.question: If α and β are zeros of x² − 4x + 3, then the value of α²β + αβ² is:
questions.explanation: α²β + αβ² = αβ(α + β). From the polynomial, α + β = 4 and αβ = 3. So αβ(α + β) = 3 × 4 = 12.

questions.question: If the sum of zeros of kx² + 2x + 3k equals their product, then k =
questions.explanation: Sum of zeros = −2/k; product = 3k/k = 3. Setting equal: −2/k = 3 → k = −2/3.
